mapper.sql: SELECT o.id AS o_id, o.user_id AS o_user_id, o.status AS o_status, o.recipient_name AS o_recipient_name, o.phone AS o_phone, o.postal_code AS o_postal_code, o.address1 AS o_address1, o.address2 AS o_address2, o.total_amount AS o_total_amount, o.created_at AS o_created_at, o.updated_at AS o_updated_at, i.id AS i_id, i.order_id AS i_order_id, i.product_id AS i_product_id, i.product_name AS i_product_name, i.price AS i_price, i.quantity AS i_quantity, i.line_total AS i_line_total FROM orders o LEFT JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id = o.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO orders (user_id, status, recipient_name, phone, postal_code, address1, address2, total_amount, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{status}, #{recipientName}, #{phone}, #{postalCode}, #{address1}, #{address2}, #{totalAmount}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
INSERT INTO order_items (order_id, product_id, product_name, price, quantity, line_total) VALUES (#{orderId}, #{productId}, #{productName}, #{price}, #{quantity}, #{lineTotal})
mapper.select: WHERE o.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY o.created_at DESC, o.id DESC, i.id ASC
WHERE o.id = #{id} AND o.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY i.id ASC
WHERE o.id = #{id} ORDER BY i.id ASC
